text.translation: > No one seems to be here.

text.reference: レイ：ここが吾妻教授の家ね。
text.translation: Rei: This is Professor Azuma's house.

text.reference: 男の声：くそっ！吾妻のクソじじいめ！{n}どこに本をかくしやがったぁ！！
text.translation: Man's Voice: Damn that old bastard Azuma!{n}Where the hell did he hide the book?!

text.reference: タカシ：せっかく、シドの先生が異界化まで{n}してくれて、誰にも邪魔されずに{n}探せるってのによぉ。
text.translation: Takashi: Master Sid turned this place into an{n}Otherworld so I could search without anyone{n}getting in my way.

text.reference: ああっ！てっ、てめえは！{n}シドの先生に、やられたはずじゃねぇか？{n}生きていやがったのか！？
text.translation: Y-You!{n}Master Sid was supposed to have finished you!{n}You're still alive?!

text.reference: この、死にぞこないめ！{n}タカシさまが、引導渡してやらぁ！！
text.translation: You half-dead bastard!{n}The great Takashi will finish you off!

text.reference: ヤコウ！{n}テナガ！{n}アシナガ！
タカシ：な、なにぃ？{n}みんな、かたづけちまいやがった……。{n}なんて、やつだ……。
text.translation: Takashi: W-What?{n}You wiped them all out...{n}What the hell are you...?

text.reference: ……くそっ、おとしまえは、{n}つけさせてもらうぜ……。
text.translation: ...Damn it. I'll make you{n}pay for this...

text.reference: レイ：あいつ、自爆する気だよっ！！
text.translation: Rei: He's going to blow himself up!!

text.reference: タカシ：へへっ、まだ勝てねえのか。{n}まあ、こいつらと遊んでるのが、{n}おにあいだぜ。
text.translation: Takashi: Heh. Still can't beat 'em?{n}Fine. Playing with these guys{n}suits you better.

text.reference: タカシさまは、ズらからせてもらうぜ……。{n}……あっ、し、しまった爆発しちまう！
text.translation: The great Takashi is getting out of here...{n}...H-Hey! It's going to explode!
